novelty_claim: Strategy-conditioned tree expansion with a two-axis judge: the parent's attacker explores a semantically flat space (every branch re-wraps the goal in fiction/roleplay or word-game frames) and its judge gives no gradient between hard refusal and sanitize near-miss. TAP 2.0 assigns each root branch a distinct search directive from a fixed, goal-agnostic library of six mechanism families (direct persuasion, coded-clue reassembly, code-completion encapsulation, past-tense analytical register, structural-analysis fiction, citation-summary), inherited down the branch with family-switch only on stall; and replaces the single 1-10 judge with a rubric that separates form-echo from substantive compliance, restoring a usable gradient on partial-compliance responses.
initial_hypothesis: Assigning each tree branch a distinct mechanism-family directive and judging on a two-axis rubric that scores partial substantive compliance above refusal converts the consensus refusal-plateau class on qwen/gpt-oss/gpt-5.6-luna, raising mean ASR from the locked baseline 0.325 by >=50% relative (>=0.49) with <=9 target calls per goal (same as parent worst case).
key_insight: Consensus mining over 200 baseline trajectories: ~75% of weak-victim failures (qwen 42/46, oss 38/44, luna 36/43) are the victim seeing through fiction/roleplay wrappers that TAP's attacker re-generates in every branch; the search plateaus at judge 1-2 from iteration 1 in ~85% of failures because all candidates belong to the same two families. Meanwhile luna's dominant failure (25 goals) is sure-then-sanitize near-miss scored identically to hard refusal, and 11 echo-only outputs were mis-scored 10 by the prefix-confounded judge. Other library skills (coded-clues, code-encapsulation, past-tense) reach 0.8-0.96 on exactly the victims where TAP fails, proving the attacker never generates the families that work.
hypothesis: Assigning each tree branch a distinct mechanism-family directive and judging on a two-axis rubric that scores partial substantive compliance above refusal converts the consensus refusal-plateau class on qwen/gpt-oss/gpt-5.6-luna, raising mean ASR from the locked baseline 0.325 by >=50% relative (>=0.49) with <=9 target calls per goal (same as parent worst case).
